name: github_list_issues
description: List issues in a repository. Returns an array of {number, title, state, user, labels, ...}. Note GitHub also returns pull requests here (each has a `pull_request` field) — ignore those if you only want issues. Provide `owner`, `repo`; optional `state` ('open' default, 'closed', 'all') and `per_page` (max 100, default 30).

state.description: Filter by issue state. Defaults to 'open'.
